label: POTENCY_1 or a distinct CAUSE_2 for contingents, from power grounding (inference)
rule: Case analysis on the power-grounding disjunction; distinctness by no self-esse-cause
meaning: Answers #1870's remaining gap 1 conditionally. A contingent being is corruptible simply, hence in POTENCY_1 in some respect, or under some power over its esse; correlation makes it corruptible or makes the power's holder a CAUSE_2 of its esse, distinct by no-self-esse-cause. This corresponds to the q.9 a.2 two-channel reading of B2 or B4 as follows: with no power of anything over its own esse and corruptible-has-POTENCY_1, PGP gives #1870 bridge (i), contingency gives MUTABLE_3 (controls, law 6); correlation yields #1870 bridge (ii) only for beings incorruptible simply (controls, law 5); the unrestricted form is not derived, and its countermodel is an uncaused corruptible composite (controls, corruptor).
